claims.claim: MCP clients cannot read or write another user's private Buzzberg data.
claims.mechanism: The server resolves OAuth tokens and personal keys to a server-side user context. Private feed reads and write tools use that context without user_id overrides. Feed queries are owner-scoped and bypass shared result caches.

claims.claim: Private feed reads and writes require account-backed authentication.
claims.mechanism: Requests authenticated with the deprecated static key do not receive a user context, so private feed reads and write tools fail closed.

claims.claim: Buzzberg does not receive the full Claude transcript.
claims.mechanism: MCP clients send only selected tool calls and their arguments to the server. Those arguments are visible to Buzzberg.

claims.claim: Installer code is public and small.
claims.mechanism: The PyPI package contains only stdlib-based client config writers and docs; the server implementation remains private during beta.
